verdict.rationale: Text was retrieved from both the main portal (guidance and news entry points such as 'esclarecimentos sobre as obrigações tributárias' and 'Destaques e Atualidades') and the info.portaldasfinancas.gov.pt guidance site (service-unavailability notices), and the llms.txt probe got a plain HTTP 404 rather than a challenge page. Together these suggest the public reading surface answers non-browser fetches. However, the captured content is mostly navigation tiles and SharePoint chrome ('Follow this site', 'Turn on more accessible mode'), so it is unclear whether full guidance articles render without JavaScript. Missing for 10: an explicit probe confirming no bot wall or CAPTCHA for an identified agent user agent, evidence that substantive guidance-article bodies are server-rendered rather than a JS-only shell, and independent hands-on corroboration of keyless agent access.
